name: memory-wiki
description: Turns claude-memory's weekly rollups and flat Tier-3 concepts into a cross-linked, searchable wiki. init scaffolds the wiki layer; ingest distils the un-ingested rollups and inbox captures into typed pages, regenerates the index and appends the append-only ledger; one SessionStart hook puts that index (a symptom lookup and a component map) in front of the model at every session start, and a second reminds you when rollups are still un-ingested; lint audits broken wikilinks, orphan pages, missing frontmatter and schema errors, and reports without ever fixing. Reads what claude-memory writes and never modifies it, and never deletes anything.
